schema: everything ingested into the project, what it contained, and what it changed. append only.

documents.name: Iowa Survey Draft.xlsx
documents.contained: Property address, city, acreage, distance to transmission line, distance to substation, wetland notes, FEMA flood zone, listing agent and contact.
documents.gaps: No parcel IDs, no county, no submarket, no zoning, no owner names.

documents.name: CoStar Sites - IA.xlsx
documents.contained: Three stacked blocks — a CoStar export across 23 columns, LandWatch results with acreage and hydrology, and Land.com auction listings.
documents.gaps: The CoStar block carried Energy Star and LEED columns but no acreage or lot size, leaving five records unscoreable. One tract duplicated a record already present from the survey draft.

documents.name: USDA 2022 Census of Agriculture — Iowa county tables
documents.contained: Farms, land in farms, average and median farm size, and farms-by-size brackets for every Iowa county.
documents.yielded: Median farm size by county, which makes owners-per-section computable
documents.gaps: Counts operations rather than ownerships, so owners-per-section is an optimistic floor until calibrated against a real parcel dissolve.

how_to_add: Send any file — spreadsheet, PDF, notes, call log, parcel export, photos of a plat book page. It gets normalised into the schema, appended, and pushed. The site updates in about thirty seconds and the analysis re-runs against the new totals.
